import RNA reads and DNA reads as a ArchR project

Source: R/createArchRproj.R
createArchRproj.Rd

import RNA reads and DNA reads as a ArchR project

createArchRproj(
  rnaFiles,
  atacFiles,
  bmap,
  barcodesFun = function(x) {
do.call(rbind, strsplit(colnames(x), "_"))[, 4]
 },
  outputDirectory = "ArchR_proj",
  annotationGenes = NULL,
  minTSS = 1,
  minFrags = 1000,
  ...,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

rnaFiles, atacFiles

A named characters. The file path of RNA and DNA count matrix files.

bmap, barcodesFun

The parameter required by replace_RNA_barcode.

outputDirectory

The output folder the the merged RNA and DNA ArchR project

annotationGenes

If there is not standard annotations available, please input the gene annotations in GRanges object with symbols metadata

minTSS, minFrags

The parameters for createArrowFiles.

...

Parameters used by createArrowFiles.

verbose

Print message or not.

Value

An ArchRProject object.
